fixture_purpose: THIS IS THE LOAD-BEARING EVIDENCE FIXTURE FOR GATE-TRUMPRX. It establishes WHY every primary source read failed, and specifically refutes the tempting-but-wrong conclusion that trumprx.gov itself blocks automated clients.
source_type_note: Labeled primary_government only to satisfy the enum; this is in fact local environment telemetry, not an external source. It makes no drug-price claim.

extracted.finding: The HTTP 403 responses observed for trumprx.gov were generated by THIS SESSION'S OWN EGRESS PROXY at the CONNECT stage. No TLS session and no HTTP request ever reached trumprx.gov. Nothing whatsoever was learned about what trumprx.gov permits or denies.
extracted.mechanism: curl reports: 'curl: (56) CONNECT tunnel failed, response 403'. The proxy status endpoint records kind='connect_rejected', detail='gateway answered 403 to CONNECT (policy denial or upstream failure)'.

control_test_that_proves_it_is_not_site_.interpretation: example.com does not block bots. A 403 for example.com proves the denial is a blanket egress policy in this environment, NOT a property of any target site.

extracted.consequence_for_rules_of_evidence: EVERY domain on this gate's primary-source allowlist is unreachable from this environment. Therefore ZERO figures in this gate can attain confidence 'confirmed'. Every TrumpRx price value is recorded as null / 'unverified'.
extracted.circumvention_explicitly_declined: The proxy README at /root/.ccr/README.md states, for the 403/407 failure class: 'The destination host is not allowed by your organization's egress policy for this session. Do not retry or route around it - report the blocked host.' Other MCP fetch-capable tools were present in this session and were deliberately NOT used to tunnel to blocked hosts, because doing so would circumvent an organizational egress policy. The block is reported, not bypassed.
extracted.what_would_be_required_to_close_this_gat: An allowlist entry permitting egress to trumprx.gov (and the manufacturer/government domains), or a human operator pasting the rendered page content, or an out-of-band archived capture.
